Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site Dungeon Master $ 139.00 1 of 2 Select option Select option READY TO SHIP Qty $ 139.00 Add to cart View cart Part Muff, part SuperFuzz and part HM-2, the Dungeon Master sounds exactly like you want it to. Sludgy and doomy as fuck but still clear enough to not sound like total mud. Tons of volume, tons of gain, tons of sustain and tons of character. Run it full blast on the controls for maximum slaying or dial back some on the DRIVE, LOW and HIGH controls to get that unique heavy as balls sound you've been after! Newer small version is exact same circuit as large version in demos. SPECS: Smaller 4.7" x 2.6" x 1.5" 125B size enclosure, true bypass switching, common 9-12vdc center negative BOSS style power input and battery snap. Current draw 10mA. Power supply not included. TESTIMONIALS: "Dude, it functions like the HM-2 without the stigma." -Arthur Rizk(Sumerlands, Eternal Champion, etc.) "Ok....so this pedal has exceeded my expectations!!!! Exactly the sound I was looking for. Dark, fuzzy and doomy as hell!!! A++++ man!!!!!" -Robert P. (Florida) "I can’t stand being too far away, I require a powered up, plugged in DM in every room of the house!" -Sam W. (HTX) "I love it! It makes some beautifully insane sounds." -John Y. (Georgia) "It sounds incredible! It just feels awesome to get that much fuzz and still preserve the low end of my bass." -Brian D. (California) "this thing is amazing!!! I seriously don't want to stop playing it!!! Pure filthy sonic destruction. I will definitely be ordering from you again. You can really see and feel the pride in your work. This thing is a masterpiece! Thank you so much for creating this monster!!!" -Sean R. (Pennsylvania) "This Dungeon Master is badass. I was not expecting so much low end and octaves. Fucking love it. First couple of chords made me think D.R.I Crossover/Four of a Kind era through my rig. Thanks! Neighbors are gonna hate me now!" -Jason R. (Tennessee) "It rips! Absolutely loving it and having a blast! This thing sounds mean and huge. Been playing though a death by audio echo dream 2 and it’s a great combo. Thanks so much!" -Adam D. (Rhode Island) "This thing is a beast. It's like a box of doom. I love all the bass on tap." -Daniel R. (Oklahoma) "The Dungeon Master is such an incredibly DARK subterranean tone, unlike anything I"ve ever heard." -Ilias I.
